cards.ex: We got our wires crossed and I ended up buying two tickets instead of one.
cards.exUz: Biz chalkashib ketdik va men bitta o'rniga ikkita chipta sotib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri tushunish, adashish yoki xato qilish, ayniqsa aloqada.

cards.ex: I had to jump through so many hoops to get my visa approved.
cards.exUz: Vizani tasdiqlatish uchun juda ko'p qiyinchiliklarni yengib o'tishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p qiyinchiliklarni yengib o'tish, keraksiz talablarni bajarish.

cards.ex: Applying for that job was a shot in the dark, but I got it!
cards.exUz: U ishga ariza topshirish ko'r-ko'rona urinish edi, lekin men uni oldim!
cards.uzDef: Omadga ishonib qilingan, muvaffaqiyat ehtimoli kam bo'lgan urinish.

cards.ex: The elephant in the room is that nobody likes our boss.
cards.exUz: Hamma biladigan muammo shuki, hech kim bizning boshliqni yoqtirmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma biladigan, lekin gapirilmaydigan katta muammo.

cards.ex: It's time for us to bury the hatchet and move on.
cards.exUz: Arazni unutib, oldinga siljish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchiliklarni unutib, yarashish, do'stlashish.

cards.ex: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the cost of the project?
cards.exUz: Loyiha narxi uchun taxminiy raqam bera olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Aniq bo'lmagan, taxminiy miqdor yoki qiymat.

cards.ex: He'll clean his room when pigs fly.
cards.exUz: U xonasini qachon tozalaydi? Hech qachon.
cards.uzDef: Hech qachon sodir bo'lmaydigan narsa, imkonsiz voqea.

cards.ex: His jokes went down like a lead balloon at the meeting.
cards.exUz: Uning hazillari yig'ilishda yaxshi qabul qilinmadi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon qabul qilinmoq, muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash.

cards.ex: He's finally getting a taste of his own medicine after being so rude.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat o'zining qo'polligi uchun jazosini olmoqda.
cards.term: A taste of your own medicine
cards.uzDef: O'zing qilgan yomonlikni boshdan kechirish.

cards.ex: Keep your chin up, things will get better.
cards.exUz: Ruhdan tushma, hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Kayfiyatni tushirmaslik, umidsizlikka tushmaslik.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what she really means.
cards.exUz: Uning asl ma'nosini tushunish uchun pardadagi ma'noni o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yashirin ma'noni tushunish, aytilmagan narsani anglash.

cards.ex: I need to get something off my chest, it's been bothering me for days.
cards.exUz: Men dildagi gapni aytishim kerak, u meni bir necha kundan beri bezovta qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni qiynayotgan narsani aytish, xotirjam bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm still on the fence about whether to accept the new job.
cards.exUz: Men hali ham yangi ishni qabul qilish yoki qilmaslik haqida ikkilanyapman.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilishga ikkilanish, bir tomonda bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: I bent over backwards to help him, but he still wasn't happy.
cards.exUz: Men unga yordam berish uchun juda ko'p harakat qildim, lekin u hali ham xursand emas edi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir xursand qilish uchun juda ko'p harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He's so focused on the details that he's missing the forest for the trees.
cards.exUz: U detallarga shunchalik e'tibor qaratganki, katta rasmni ko'rmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Katta rasmni ko'rmaslik, faqat kichik narsalarga e'tibor qaratish.

cards.ex: She keeps her cards close to her chest, so you never know what she's planning.
cards.exUz: U rejalashtirayotganini hech qachon bilmaysiz, chunki u rejalaringizni yashiradi.
cards.uzDef: Rejalaringizni yashirish, sirni oshkor qilmaslik.

cards.ex: Technology can be a double-edged sword; it can help us, but also harm us.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya ikki tomonlama qilich bo'lishi mumkin; u bizga yordam berishi mumkin, lekin zarar ham keltirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ham foydali, ham zararli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Remember, all that glitters is not gold.
cards.exUz: Esdan chiqarmang, hamma yaltiroq narsa ham oltin emas.
cards.uzDef: Yuzaki ko'rinishga aldanmaslik kerak, hamma yaltiroq narsa ham oltin emas.

cards.ex: Actions speak louder than words; show me what you can do.
cards.exUz: Amallar so'zlardan muhimroq; menga nima qila olishingizni ko'rsating.
cards.uzDef: Amal gapdan muhimroq, ish ko'rsatish kerak.

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, shuning uchun boshidan boshlash kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragandan keyin, boshidan boshlash.

cards.ex: Don't bite the hand that feeds you; be grateful for what you have.
cards.exUz: Sizni boqayotgan qo'lni tishlamang; bor narsangiz uchun minnatdor bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshilik qilgan odamga yomonlik qilish.

cards.ex: He burned his bridges with his old company when he quit.
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shaganida eski kompaniyasi bilan aloqalarini buzdi.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarni butunlay buzish, qaytib bo'lmaydigan holatga keltirish.

cards.ex: I'm caught between a rock and a hard place; I don't know what to do.
cards.exUz: Men qiyin ahvoldaman; nima qilishni bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Ikki yomon vaziyat orasida qolib ketish.

cards.ex: There's no use crying over spilt milk; just move on.
cards.exUz: O'tgan ishga salovatning foydasi yo'q; shunchaki oldinga siljing.
cards.uzDef: O'tgan narsaga achinish, foydasi yo'q bo'lgan narsaga qayg'urish.

cards.ex: He came from behind to win the race, a true dark horse.
cards.exUz: U poygada g'alaba qozonish uchun orqadan keldi, haqiqiy kutilmagan g'olib.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan g'olib, ilgari e'tiborga olinmagan shaxs.

cards.ex: Don't put all your eggs in one basket; diversify your investments.
cards.exUz: Barcha resurslaringizni bitta narsaga tikmang; investitsiyalaringizni diversifikatsiya qiling.
cards.uzDef: Barcha resurslarni bitta narsaga tikmaslik, xavfni kamaytirish.

cards.ex: Even though he's struggling now, every dog has its day.
cards.exUz: Hozirda qiynalayotgan bo'lsa ham, har kimning muvaffaqiyatga erishadigan vaqti keladi.
cards.uzDef: Har kimning muvaffaqiyatga erishadigan vaqti keladi.

cards.ex: It's hard to get a foot in the door in this industry.
cards.exUz: Bu sohada yo'lni boshlash qiyin.
cards.term: Get a foot in the door
cards.uzDef: Birinchi qadamni qo'yish, imkoniyat yaratish.

cards.ex: He has a chip on his shoulder because he feels he's been treated unfairly.
cards.exUz: U o'zini adolatsiz munosabatda bo'lishgan deb his qilgani uchun arazli.
cards.uzDef: O'zini past baholash, arazli bo'lish.

cards.ex: She hit the ground running and quickly became a valuable member of the team.
cards.exUz: U yangi ishni tez va samarali boshladi va tezda jamoaning qimmatli a'zosiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ishni tez va samarali boshlash.
